old_card.title: Old Grocy dashboard card still loaded
old_card.description:
An old copy of the Grocy dashboard card was found: {found}.

Grocy Pro now brings its own card, and the old copy can win and show an outdated version (for example "Nothing here ??").

1. Go to **Settings > Dashboards**, open the menu (three dots) > **Resources** and delete the `grocy-action-card.js` resource.
2. Delete `/config/www/grocy-action-card.js` if it exists.
3. Reload the browser (or clear the app cache on your phone).

This message goes away by itself once the old copy is gone and Home Assistant restarts.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish installing Grocy Pro
restart_required.description:
Grocy Pro needs grocy-py {required}. Installed: {installed}. Loaded in memory: {loaded}.

The old Grocy integration used grocy-py 0.1.0, and Python keeps that version in memory until Home Assistant restarts. **Restart Home Assistant** (Settings > System > Restart) and Grocy Pro will load. If this message stays after a restart, check the log for errors while installing grocy-py.
